why: This is an open-ended research programme, not a single resolvable claim. Searches found an active 2025 literature on word-representable graphs (representation numbers, complexity of recognition, temporal/co-bipartite extensions, modular decomposition), but nothing that answers the general question of which hard graph problems translate to efficient word problems; these are all specific sub-results in a broader, ongoing program rather than a resolution of the bullet itself.
